paragraphs: iHeartMedia is the number one audio media company in the U.S. based on consumer reach.
Within the audio industry, companies operate in two primary sectors: •The ‘music collection' sector, which essentially replaced downloads and CDs, and

•The ‘companionship' sector, in which people regard radio and podcasting personalities as their trusted friends and companions on whom they rely to provide coverage on everything from entertainment, local news, storytelling, information about new music and artists, weather, traffic, sports and more.

We operate in the second sector and use our large scale and national reach in broadcast radio to build additional complementary platforms. We believe we are the only major multi-platform audio media company, and each platform is complementary to the others, building on and extending our companionship relationship with the consumer.
Our product strategy is to be where our listeners are with the products and services they expect from us regardless of where they are and what platforms they are using.

Our radio stations, podcasts and other content can be heard across a broad range of audio platforms, including our AM/FM broadcast radio stations; HD digital radio stations; the Internet at iHeart.com, our radio stations' websites, and certain Metaverse platforms; and through our iHeartRadio mobile application on 500+ platforms and thousands of devices, including enhanced automotive dashes, on tablets, wearables and smartphones, on gaming consoles, via in-home entertainment (including smart televisions) and voice-controlled smart speaker devices. All of this is supported by the largest audio sales force in the United States, executing on the strategy of any seller, anywhere being able to sell anything, supported by our unique technology.

•Broadcast radio: We have a strong relationship with our consumers, and our broadcast radio audience has the largest reach of any audio company in the U.S., with an audience that is over twice as large as that of the next largest commercial broadcast radio company, as measured by Nielsen.

•Digital: Our iHeartRadio digital platform is the number one streaming broadcast radio platform, with nearly five times the digital listening hours of the next largest commercial broadcast radio company, as measured by our subsidiary Triton.

•Podcasts: We are the number one podcast publisher in the U.S., according to Podtrac. We are the only podcast publisher with podcasts ranked in all 19 of Podtrac's content categories and we have the most top 10 shows of any podcast publisher, as measured by Podtrac.

•Ad Tech: We are the only company able to provide a complete ad tech solution for all forms of audio: on demand, broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting. For our advertising customers, the combination of these services creates a one-of-a-kind cross-platform advertising solution that spans all of audio with data targeting and attribution measurement solutions.

•Social media: Our personalities, stations and brands have a social footprint that includes over 345 million fans and followers as measured by Shareablee, which is eleven times the size of the next largest commercial broadcast audio media company. This social footprint was at the heart of delivering over 63 billion social media impressions for our 2025 iHeartRadio Music Festival.

•Events: We have live and virtual events including seven major nationally-recognized tentpole events. These events provide significant opportunities for consumer promotion, advertising and social amplification.

The unification of our many brands across these diverse product offerings under the "iHeartRadio" masterbrand has allowed us to build out new platforms as well as extend into third-party platforms like social media, the Metaverse, and television, as well as streaming services.

Our superior local, national, and online sales force combined with our leading digital, events, content, and representation business position us to cover a wide range of advertiser categories, including consumer services, retailers, entertainment, health and beauty products, telecommunications, automotive, media and political.

headings: Our results have been in the past, and could be in the future, adversely affected by economic or political uncertainty or deterioration in economic conditions and corresponding reduced spending by advertisers.
The success of our business is dependent upon advertising revenues, which are seasonal, cyclical, and may fluctuate as a result of a number of factors, some of which are beyond our control.
We face intense competition in our business.
Alternative media and entertainment platforms and technologies may continue to increase competition with our operations.
Our business is dependent upon the performance of on-air talent, program hosts, and acquisition of programming.
Emerging industry trends may adversely impact our ability to generate revenue from our digital advertising inventory and materially adversely affect our business, operations, and financial condition.
If events occur that damage our reputation and brand, our ability to grow our user base, advertiser relationships, and partnerships may be impaired and our business may be harmed.
Our business is dependent on our management team and other key individuals.
Our financial performance may be adversely affected by many factors within or beyond our control.
Acquisitions, dispositions and other strategic investments or transactions could pose risks.

We use artificial intelligence ("AI") in our business, and challenges in managing its use could result in reputational harm, competitive disadvantage, legal liability, and adverse effects on our results of operations.
We have engaged in restructuring activities in the past and may implement further restructurings in the future and our restructuring efforts may not be successful or generate expected cost savings.
Our substantial indebtedness may adversely affect our financial health and operating flexibility.
Extensive current government regulation, and future regulation, may limit our radio broadcasting and other operations or adversely affect our business and financial results.
Legislation and royalty audits may require us to pay additional royalties, including to additional parties such as record labels or recording artists.
Environmental, health, safety and land use laws and regulations may limit or restrict some of our operations.
We may face lawsuits, incur liability or suffer reputational harm as a result of content published or made available through our services.
We are subject to a series of risks regarding scrutiny and regulation of environmental, social, and governance matters.
Risks Related to our Class A Common Stock
We do not intend to pay dividends on our Class A common stock for the foreseeable future.
We are a holding company and rely on dividends, distributions and other payments, advances and transfers of funds from our subsidiaries to meet our obligations.
Delaware law and certain provisions in our certificate of incorporation may prevent efforts by our stockholders to change the direction or management of our company.
Regulations imposed by the Communications Act and the FCC limit the foreign individuals or entities that may invest in our capital stock without FCC approval.
paragraphs: We derive revenues from the sale of advertising. As is common in the audio entertainment industry, advertisers do not have long-term advertising commitments with us and can terminate their contracts at any time. Expenditures by advertisers tend to be cyclical, reflecting economic and political conditions and budgeting and buying patterns. Periods of a slowing economy or recession, or periods of economic uncertainty, may be accompanied by a decrease in advertising. Macroeconomic uncertainty continued to impact our advertising revenues during the year ended December 31, 2025. This impact in advertising revenues has had an adverse effect on our profit margins, cash flow and liquidity. If macroeconomic uncertainty continues or increases, or if economic conditions deteriorate, we may continue to experience an adverse impact on our revenue, profit margins, cash flow and liquidity as a result. In addition, inflation has the potential to adversely affect our liquidity, business, financial condition and results of operations by increasing our overall cost structure, particularly if we are unable to achieve commensurate increases in the prices we charge our customers. Similarly, political conditions, including new and changing laws or tariffs, regulations, executive orders and enforcement priorities, may impact customer budgets and create uncertainty about how such laws and regulations will be interpreted and applied, which may impact advertising customer demand and adversely impact our business. Furthermore, because a significant portion of our revenue is derived from local advertisers, our ability to generate revenues in specific markets is directly affected by local and regional conditions, and unfavorable regional economic conditions also may adversely impact our results. In addition, even in the absence of a downturn in general economic conditions, an individual business sector or market may experience a downturn, causing it to reduce its advertising expenditures, which also may adversely impact our results.

We are required to evaluate our goodwill, indefinite-lived and definite-lived intangible assets for impairment. We perform our annual impairment test on our goodwill and FCC licenses as of July 1 of each year. In addition, we test for impairment of intangible assets whenever events and circumstances indicate that such assets might be impaired. While we believe we have made reasonable estimates and utilized appropriate assumptions to calculate the estimated fair value of our reporting units and FCC licenses, it is possible a material change could occur. We have taken material impairment charges in recent periods and if future results are not consistent with our assumptions and estimates, including as a result of increased economic uncertainty or deterioration in economic conditions, we may be exposed to impairment charges in the future.
Our main source of revenue is the sale of advertising. Our ability to sell advertising depends on, among other things:
•economic conditions; •national and local demand for radio and digital advertising; •the popularity of our programming;
•local and national advertising price fluctuations, which can be affected by the availability of programming and the relative supply of and demand for commercial advertising;
•the capability and effectiveness of our sales organization;

paragraphs: Consolidated revenues for the year ended December 31, 2025 increased primarily due to an increase in digital and podcast advertising revenue driven by a continued increase in demand for digital advertising and an increase in non-cash trade revenue resulting from strategic marketing initiatives, partially offset by a decrease in political revenues in our Multiplatform Group and Audio and Media Service Group as 2024 was a presidential election year, as well as lower spending on radio advertising as a result of continued uncertain market conditions.
The key developments in our business for the year ended December 31, 2025 are summarized below:
•Consolidated Revenue of $3,865.0 million increased $10.5 million, or 0.3%, during 2025 compared to Consolidated Revenue of $3,854.5 million in 2024.
•Multiplatform Group Revenue decreased $99.4 million, or 4.2%, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA decreased $47.0 million, or 10.2%, compared to 2024.
•Digital Audio Group Revenue increased $164.9 million, or 14.2%, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA increased $77.8 million, or 20.5%, compared to 2024.
•Audio & Media Services Group Revenue decreased $54.5 million, or 16.7%, and Segment Adjusted EBITDA decreased $47.2 million, or 33.6%, compared to 2024.

•Operating loss of $20.6 million improved $742.5 million from Operating loss of $763.1 million in 2024. 2025 included $213.9 million of non-cash impairment charges primarily related to our FCC licenses. 2024 included $922.7 million of non-cash impairment charges primarily related to our goodwill and FCC licenses balances.
•Net loss of $471.9 million improved $537.6 million compared to Net loss of $1,009.5 million in 2024.
•Cash flows provided by operating activities of $92.6 million increased $21.2 million from $71.4 million in 2024.
•Adjusted EBITDA(1) of $685.8 million decreased $19.9 million from $705.6 million in 2024.
•Free cash flow(2) of $10.9 million increased $37.1 million from $(26.2) million in 2024.

paragraphs: iHeartMedia 是美國根據消費者觸達數量而言的首屈一指的音訊媒體公司。
在音訊產業中，公司主要運作於兩個主要領域：•「音樂收藏」領域，該領域基本上取代了下載與CD，以及
•「陪伴」領域，在此領域中，人們將電臺與播客節目主持人視為他們的可信朋友與夥伴，依賴他們提供從娛樂、地方新聞、故事敘述、新音樂與藝人的資訊、天氣、交通、體育等各方面的報導。
我們運作於第二個領域，並利用我們的規模與全國性觸達力，來建立額外的補充性平台。我們認為我們是唯一主要的多平台音訊媒體公司，且每個平台彼此補充，延展我們與消費者之間的陪伴關係。
我們的產品策略是無論消費者在哪裡、使用什麼平台，我們都提供他們預期的產品與服務。

我們的電臺、播客及其他內容可以透過廣泛的音訊平台聽到，包括我們的AM/FM廣播電臺；HD數位電臺；iHeart.com 網站、我們電臺網站以及某些元宇宙平台；以及透過 iHeartRadio 移動應用程式，在 500 多個平台與數千種裝置上，包括增強型車載顯示幕、平板電腦、穿戴裝置與智慧型手機、遊戲主機、家庭娛樂（包括智慧電視）以及語音控制的智慧音箱裝置。所有這些都由美國最大的音訊銷售團隊支持，執行任何賣家、任何地方都能銷售任何商品的策略，並由我們獨特的技術支援。
•廣播電臺：我們與消費者有強大的關係，且我們的廣播電臺觀眾觸達力是美國任何音訊公司的最大，其觀眾人數超過第二大商業廣播電臺公司的兩倍以上，以尼爾森的數據為準。
•數位平台：我們的 iHeartRadio 數位平台是美國排名第一的串流廣播電臺平台，其數位聆聽時數幾乎是第二大商業廣播電臺公司的五倍，以我們子公司 Triton 的數據為準。
•Podcasts: 我們是美國排名第一的播客發行商，根據 Podtrac 的資料。我們是唯一一家播客發行商，其播客在 Podtrac 的 19 種內容類別中均有排名，且我們擁有任何播客發行商中最多的前十名節目，根據 Podtrac 的數據。
•Ad Tech: 我們是唯一一家能夠為所有形式的音訊提供完整廣告科技解決方案的公司：隨選、廣播電臺、數位串流電臺和播客。對於我們的廣告客戶，這些服務的組合創造了一種獨一無二的跨平台廣告解決方案，涵蓋所有音訊領域，並包含資料定位與歸因測量解決方案。
•社交媒體：我們的個性、電臺與品牌擁有社交影響力，包含逾 345 百萬名粉絲與追蹤者，根據 Shareablee 的測量，其規模為次大商業廣播音訊媒體公司的十一倍。此社交影響力是我們 2025 iHeartRadio 音樂節達成逾 63 十億社交媒體曝光量的核心。
•Events: 我們擁有實體與虛擬活動，包括七項 nationally-recognized 的大型活動。這些活動為消費者宣傳、廣告與社交擴散提供了重要的機會。
將我們多樣化的產品組合在這些不同的產品組合下統合於 "iHeartRadio" 主品牌之下，使我們得以建立新的平台，並拓展至第三方平台，例如社交媒體、元宇宙、電視以及串流服務。
我們優秀的本地、國家與線上銷售團隊，加上我們在數位、活動、內容與代表業務上的領導地位，使我們能夠覆蓋廣泛的廣告客戶類別，包括消費服務、零售商、娛樂、健康與美容產品、電信業者、汽車、媒體與政治。

paragraphs: 本公司合併營業收入於2025年12月31日財務年度增加，主要係因數位及播客廣告收入增加，驅動因素為數位廣告需求持續增加，以及非現金貿易收入增加，係因戰略性行銷活動，部分抵銷因2024年為總統選舉年，使本公司多媒體集團及音訊與媒體服務集團政治收入減少，以及市場條件持續不確定，導致電臺廣告支出減少。
本公司於2025年12月31日財務年度之關鍵業務發展如下：
•合併營業收入 3,865.0 百萬美元，較 2024 年合併營業收入 3,854.5 百萬美元增加 10.5 百萬美元，成長 0.3%
•多媒體集團營業收入減少99.4百萬美元，或4.2%，且該分部調整後營業息稅折舊及 amortization（EBITDA）減少47.0百萬美元，或10.2%，較2024年。
•數位音訊集團營業收入增加164.9百萬美元，或14.2%，且該分部調整後營業息稅折舊及 amortization（EBITDA）增加77.8百萬美元，或20.5%，較2024年。
•音訊與媒體服務集團營業收入減少54.5百萬美元，或16.7%，且該分部調整後營業息稅折舊及 amortization（EBITDA）減少47.2百萬美元，或33.6%，較2024年。
•營運虧損為20.6百萬美元，較2024年營運虧損763.1百萬美元改善742.5百萬美元。2025年包含213.9百萬美元非現金減損費用，主要係因本公司FCC執照。2024年包含922.7百萬美元非現金減損費用，主要係因本公司 goodwill 及FCC執照餘額。
•淨虧損為471.9百萬美元，較2024年淨虧損1,009.5百萬美元改善537.6百萬美元。
•營運活動產生的現金流為 92.6 百萬美元，較 2024 年的 71.4 百萬美元增加 21.2 百萬美元。
•調整後的 EBITDA(1) 為 685.8 百萬美元，較 2024 年的 705.6 百萬美元減少 19.9 百萬美元。
•自由現金流(2) 為 10.9 百萬美元，較 2024 年的 (26.2) 百萬美元增加 37.1 百萬美元。

headings: 與本公司業務相關之風險
本公司過往之營運成果，或未來可能因總體經濟或政治不確定性，或經濟條件惡化，導致廣告支出減少而受到不利影響。
本公司業務之成功取決於廣告收入，而廣告收入具有季節性與週期性，並可能因多種因素而波動，其中一些因素為本公司所無法控制。
本公司業務面臨激烈競爭。
替代性媒體與娛樂平台及技術可能持續增加與本公司營運之競爭。
本公司業務依賴於節目主持人、節目取得及現場人才之表現。
產業新興趨勢可能不利於本公司從數位廣告存貨產生收入，並對本公司業務、營運及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
若發生損害本公司聲譽與品牌的事件，可能影響本公司拓展用戶羣體、廣告客戶關係及合作夥伴關係之能力，進而損害本公司業務。
本公司業務依賴於管理團隊及其他關鍵人員。
財務表現可能受到許多在本公司控制範圍內或之外的因素不利影響。
收購、處置及其他戰略投資或交易可能帶來風險。
本公司在業務中使用人工智慧（"AI"），在管理其使用方面遇到的挑戰可能導致聲譽損害、競爭優勢喪失、法律責任及對營業成果產生不利影響。
本公司過去曾進行過重整活動，未來可能實施進一步重整，且本公司重整努力可能無法成功或產生預期的成本節省。
與本公司負債相關的風險
本公司龐大負債可能對財務狀況及營運彈性產生不利影響。
法規、立法及訴訟相關風險
廣泛的現行政府規範，以及未來可能的規範，可能限制我們的電臺廣播及其他營運，或對我們的業務與財務結果產生不利影響。
立法與版稅稽查可能要求我們支付額外的版稅，包括支付給其他當事人如唱片公司或錄音藝人。
環境、健康、安全及土地使用法規與規範可能限制或限制我們的部分營運。
我們可能因透過本服務發布或提供內容而面臨訴訟、產生責任或遭受聲譽損害。
我們面臨一連串風險，涉及環境、社會及治理事項的監督與規範。
與我們A類普通股相關的風險
我們不打算在可預見的未來向我們的A類普通股支付股息。
我們是一家控股公司，並依賴我們子公司支付的股息、分紅及其他付款、貸款及資金轉移以履行我們的義務。
德拉瓦州法律以及我們公司章程中的某些條款可能阻止股東嘗試改變本公司的方向或管理層。
根據通訊法及聯邦通信委員會（FCC）所頒布的規範，未經FCC批准，限制外國個人或機構投資本公司資本股票。
paragraphs: 我們的營業收入來自廣告銷售。如同在音響娛樂產業中常見的現象，廣告客戶與我們並無長期的廣告承諾，且可隨時終止其契約。廣告支出通常具有週期性，反映總體經濟與政治條件以及預算與採購模式。經濟減速或衰退時期，或經濟不確定時期，可能伴隨廣告支出減少。總體經濟不確定性持續影響我們在2025年12月31日財務年度的廣告收入。此影響已對我們的毛利率、現金流與流動性產生負面影響。若總體經濟不確定性持續或增加，或經濟條件惡化，我們可能繼續因之而對營業收入、毛利率、現金流與流動性產生負面影響。此外，通貨膨脹可能透過提高我們的總體成本結構，對我們的流動性、業務、財務狀況與營運成果產生負面影響，特別是在我們無法實現與所收取客戶價格相稱的價格上漲時。同樣地，政治條件，包括新法規或關稅、法規、行政命令與執法優先順序，可能影響客戶預算，並造成對這些法規與法規如何被解釋與執行的不確定性，這可能影響廣告客戶需求，並對我們的業務產生負面影響。此外，因為我們的收入有相當大一部分來自本地廣告客戶，我們在特定市場產生收入的能力會直接受到當地與區域條件的影響，而不利的區域經濟條件也可能對我們的結果產生負面影響。此外，即使在總體經濟條件未出現衰退的情況下，個別產業或市場可能經歷衰退，導致其減少廣告支出，這也可能對我們的結果產生負面影響。

我們被要求評估我們的商譽、無限期與有限期限的無形資產是否發生減損。我們每年在7月1日對我們的商譽與FCC執照進行年度減損測試。此外，我們在事件與情況顯示這些資產可能減損時，會進行無形資產的減損測試。雖然我們認為我們已做出合理的估計並使用適當的假設來計算我們應報告分部與FCC執照的預估公平價值，但仍有發生重大變動的可能性。我們在近期期間已提列重大減損費用，若未來結果與我們的假設與估計不一致，包括因增加的總體經濟不確定性或經濟條件惡化所致，我們可能在未來面臨減損費用。
我們的主要收入來源是廣告銷售。我們銷售廣告的能力取決於多種因素，包括：
•總體經濟條件；•國家與地方對廣播與數位廣告的需求；•我們節目的人氣；
•地方與國家廣告價格波動，這可能受到節目可得性與商業廣告供應與需求的相對關係所影響；
•我們銷售團隊的能力建設與成效；
